content: The customer, Shaurya Joshi, inquires about reinstating an old health policy or upgrading to a new one with dental and vision coverage. The insurance agent, Neha Kapoor, explains the options, detailing a 10% higher premium for the new policy offset by a 5% temporary discount, and clarifies that major dental procedures have a 6-month waiting period. The agent also mentions sending a brochure via email, and the customer asks about the activation timeline for the upgraded policy.

action_items: Customer to review the policy brochure sent via email
Agent to confirm policy activation timeline if customer decides to upgrade
